method: One-step-ahead CPI target after latest actual CPI month; AR-MIDAS uses the latest actual monthly CPI lag and 12 weekly Brent log returns when available.
evaluation_note: Historical scores use month-end calendar cutoffs, not archived real-time vintages.
availability_policy: CPI labels must be available by the run cutoff. Brent observations are restricted to the target month and must be available by the run cutoff. Archived historical release vintages are unavailable, so a past target month is a delayed estimate, not a real-time vintage.
